Errors are ongoing through the end of the log file, at `03:59:27Z` (line 2015, last line), still unresolved, `waiting` queue now at 74. No recovery or second config generation appears in the file.

## On-Call Handoff — Gateway 503s

**Root cause**
Deploy `dep-4471` (gateway, `a.novak`) applied config generation 119 at `2026-03-14T02:13:41Z`, flipping `gateway.pool.perRequest` from `false` to `true`. This exhausts the fixed-size connection pool (`size 20`) under normal load. Every request now logs `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED acquiring connection from pool (size 20, in_use 20, waiting N)`, and `N` (queued requests) has climbed steadily from `13` to `74+` with no recovery.

**Impact window**
`02:14:18Z` (first 503) through end of available log data at `03:59:27Z`. Still ongoing, unresolved, over 1h45m in. Affects `/v1/cart`, `/v1/session`, `/v1/catalog/search`, `/v1/orders`, `/v1/checkout` across `billing-svc`, `orders-svc`, `catalog-svc`, `accounts-svc`. `worker.log` shows no impact, workers use a separate connection path.

**Rollback**
Revert `dep-4471` (`gateway.pool.perRequest: true -> false`). No other deploy in `deploys.csv` lands near the window.
